01 / The person

The little details that make you, you.

The curls, the glasses, the round eyes, the little earrings, the tiny nose ring, that small dot on your forehead — all those little details somehow became familiar parts of the person I know. And then there is the side of you that gets excited about Mahadev, Natural Star Nani, random conversations, and all the little things that make our time together ours.

AkkiThe name I'm calling you now, even though this story has already collected a whole museum of names.
AmmuluThe nickname from the older chapters — proof that time keeps changing the way I call you.
CR → Dolphin → AkkiThree eras. Three names. One person. Our naming history deserves its own documentary.
Mahadev + NaniA combination that is very specifically you — and now permanently attached to the soundtrack of our conversations.
1.5–2 yearsNot the longest chapter of a lifetime, but long enough to fill it with laughter, time together, outings and memories.
Our kind of chaosThe best part is that a normal day can turn into a story simply because we spent it together.

03 / The little things

If I had to explain why you matter...

It wouldn't be one giant reason. It would be a hundred tiny ones.

The way a conversation can suddenly turn into an hour. The jokes that only make sense because of some story from months ago. The fact that there are memories I can remember simply because you were there.

Those are the things that make a person unforgettable.

Happy Birthday,
Akshitha ❤️

Akki, this is your second birthday since we actually met in person, and somewhere in these one-and-a-half to two years, we managed to collect a lot more than just conversations. We spent time together, laughed a lot, went out a few times, and somehow turned ordinary days into memories. I don't know what every future chapter will look like, but I know this chapter has been genuinely special to me.

May your next year be full of the kind of moments that make you forget to check the time — and may you always have reasons to smile at the person you are becoming.
